description: This file defines a set of React components for a UI sheet/modal, utilizing Radix UI primitives and custom styling utilities. It includes components for overlay, content, header, footer, title, description, and control buttons, with support for different side positions and animations.

methods.name: SheetOverlay
methods.description: A React component for the overlay background of the sheet, with animated fade-in and fade-out effects.

methods.name: SheetContent
methods.description: Main content container for the sheet, supporting different side positions and including a close button.

methods.name: SheetHeader
methods.description: A container for the sheet's header section, styled for layout and spacing.

methods.name: SheetFooter
methods.description: A container for the sheet's footer section, supporting layout for actions.

methods.name: SheetTitle
methods.description: Component for the sheet's title, styled with larger font and bold text.

methods.name: SheetDescription
methods.description: Component for descriptive text within the sheet, styled with muted foreground color.
